scope: M1-M7 and M8 report, packaging and reproduction
method: Three same-model reviewers and coordinating chair; separate initial analyses, cross-rebuttal, chair adjudication, targeted correction review. Shared model/context; not external or fully blinded peer review.
verdict: Numerical synthesis survives the scoped review. Three reproduction defects corrected; saved-evidence packaging accepted with explicit archive/portability and scientific limitations.

findings.title: Raw regeneration cannot promise frozen-byte inputs in a relocated clone
findings.resolution: Guide now requires exact archived derived snapshots for hash-bound replay, distinguishes 25 scanned files from qualifying dates, and separates legacy regeneration. No hash/input change.
findings.residual: Underlying legacy portability is a disclosed limitation, not repaired or claimed portable; original raw-file byte provenance was not archived.

findings.title: M3 replay instructions can overwrite accepted phase reports
findings.proof: Changing only output_directory leaves report_directory=reports/m3; runner writes phase reports there and validation reads calibration there.
findings.resolution: Concrete guide config now sets both directories to fresh namespaces; same replay config used for both phases. Current README routes to this safe recipe.
findings.verification: Config-preparation snippet executed in scratch directory; neither canonical output touched; repeated namespace refused before simulation. Legacy runner overwrite behavior explicitly disclosed.

findings.title: Engine version enforcement claim exceeds actual gate
findings.proof: Controlled acceptance compares runtime engine with local SUMO binary; no independent expected 1.27.1 check; H0 has no controller comparison. All accepted provenance inspected reports 1.27.1.
findings.resolution: Corrected description; explicit exact-version installation remains required. No actual accepted engine mismatch found.

clarifications.resolution: Introduction now says overlay commands over all-run passenger timesteps. About 2% is not window exposure or acceleration-feedforward share.

clarifications.topic: Held-out phase split vs unseen-data blinding
clarifications.resolution: Report discloses that historical nine-date diagnostic included October 15/16. Frozen formal fitting/evaluation split and no-postfreeze-retuning claim retained; fully unseen/blinded evaluation is not certified.

reviewers.initial_and_rebuttal: One P2 reproduction finding; scientific conditional conclusion supported
M3 overwrite and engine claim findings; no accepted numerical defect established
No additional controller/numerical defect established; reproduction corrections and exposure precision supported

limitations: Same-model internal review shares project context and is not external peer review.
No full campaign or all-run trajectory-wide audit rerun.
Packet and independent live-sensor histories unavailable.
No field certification of striping, loop wiring, managed-lane eligibility or historical ramp-meter behavior.
Read-only reviewer environments could not run some real-engine/temp/Matplotlib tests; chair runs the full writable suite separately.
M3 fidelity failure, conditional demand, low overlay exposure and one-day OFAT/interactions limits remain.
